variants.splinter: A splinter. One pair of tweezers. The bill says two thousand dollars.

body.text: Nobody pays that. Not you, and not your insurance.
Your insurance agreed a price for that visit years ago. Three hundred dollars.
That is the allowed amount, and it is the only number here that is real.
Your share comes out of the three hundred, not the two thousand. At twenty percent, that is sixty dollars.
The two thousand is a sticker price. It exists so there is something to discount.
So when a bill looks enormous, read the letter before you panic.
